title: A price checker in parallel
description:
Ask several (fake) shops for a price at the same time and pick the best answer in time.

```
asking 4 shops for "keyboard"
ShopA 49.99 (120 ms), ShopB 45.50 (300 ms), ShopC failed (no stock), ShopD timed out
best: ShopB 45.50
total time: about 500 ms (the timeout), not the sum
```
hints: `orTimeout(500, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)` on each future, then `handle` turns a value, a failure or a timeout into one result record (lesson 8.02).
Only `join` after every request has been started.
requirements: Each shop is a `Function<String, CompletableFuture<BigDecimal>>` with a random delay and sometimes a failure.
Start every request at once; give each a timeout; collect results with `handle`.
Run the shops on virtual threads (`Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor()`).
Run it on your own computer with `java Main.java`: the runner in your browser does not allow real threads.
stretch: Return as soon as three shops have answered instead of waiting for the timeout.
